11	 except (InvalidOperation,ValueError,TypeError):return None
12	gaps=list(csv.DictReader((T/'inter-forward-gap-analysis-v2/rank_gaps.csv').open()));summaries=[]

14	 choices=[r for r in gaps if '_ep'+str(ep)+'_' in r['rank'] and r['target_forward_ordinal']=='7'];assert len(choices)==1

17	 db=next((ROOT/row['rank']/'ASCEND_PROFILER_OUTPUT').glob('ascend_pytorch_profiler_*.db'))
18	 c=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(db)+'?mode=ro',uri=True);c.execute('PRAGMA query_only=ON');c.execute('PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY')

27	  selected.sort(key=lambda z:z['start_relative_to_layer0_us']);bytype[table]={'count':len(selected),
